name: Termobeton
description: Termo-beton doo is a company for construction, trade and services founded on April 17, 1996.in Breza. The founders of the company are Frljak Sabit,Bachelor of Civil Engineering and Turbo Ahmed, Bachelor of Civil Engineering.
The Company`s main activity is construction (civil and building construction), production of concrete and precast concrete products, as well as reinforced concrete structures.
